import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 领赏
 * 指令：/领赏 悬赏ID
 *
 * 领取已完成悬赏的赏金
 */

import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot';
import App from '@src/response-apps/bounty/claim/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const bountyActionHeader = [
  { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
  { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
];

const bountyActionFooter = [
  { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
  { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
  { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
  { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
  { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
];

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();

  const match = text.match(/^(?:!|！|\/|#|＃)?领赏(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('格式：/领赏 悬赏编号');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '领赏',
        content: md,
        header: bountyActionHeader,
        footer: bountyActionFooter
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const bountyId = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : null;
  const result = await App({ bid, uid, bountyId, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'LIST': {
      const { pending } = result.data;

      if (pending.length === 0) {
        md.addText('暂无待领取的赏金');
        md.addNewline();

        md.addButton('悬赏榜', { data: '/悬赏榜' });
      } else {
        md.addText('待领赏金');
        md.addNewline();

        for (const p of pending) {
          md.addBlockquote(
            Format.createMarkdown()
              .addText(`${p.bountyId} 目标：${p.targetName} · ${p.rewardAmount}灵晶 `)
              .addButton(`领赏 #${p.bountyId}`, { data: `/领赏 ${p.bountyId}` })
          );
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'INVALID_ID':
      md.addText('悬赏编号无效');
      break;
    case 'INVALID_USER_STATUS':
      md.addText('你的账号状态异常，无法领赏');
      break;
    case 'NOTHING_TO_CLAIM':
      md.addText('没有可领取的赏金（未接赏或已领取）');
      break;
    case 'INVALID_REWARD_AMOUNT':
      md.addText('赏金金额异常');
      break;
    case 'FAIL':
      md.addText('领赏失败，请稍后再试');
      break;
    case 'OK':
      md.addText('领赏成功！');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`获得灵晶：${result.data.rewardAmount}`);
      break;
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '领赏',
      content: md,
      header: bountyActionHeader,
      footer: bountyActionFooter
    })
  );
});
